title: Oddly Sized
text: Oddly Sized. This particular back flow incense holder is rather large. It has a large hole in the bottom. The size makes it so the incense really doesn't travel down the waterfall well. It kind of gets lost after the first fall and dissipates around the room. The large hole in the bottom (under the last fall) is just unsightly. I've had several back flow incense holders, and this is my least favorite one I've ever had. Also, why can't they make back flow cones that smell nice? They're always that super cheap big box store type of incense smell that just smells mostly like smoke.
